description: Start a conversation with the project's agent in which you write the user's messages yourself (Test Lab, Manual testing). Nothing is sent yet. Returns its draft id; send messages with send_manual_message, score it with score_manual_test, keep it in Test Results with save_manual_test. A draft is kept for 12 hours after its last change and only you can reach it. Use it to talk to the agent under test directly, for example to reproduce a problem. Needs credits to start.

project.description: The project's number (as the app shows it, e.g. 12 or '#12') or its name. Optional when the organization has one project.
